courses.title: Engineering, Society, and You
courses.description: The development of the individual in society from an engineering perspective. The study of the integration of society and technology. Development includes introduction to the fields of engineering and engineering technology, career planning, development of a community of learners, critical thinking, problem solving skills, and ethical and professional behavior. Analysis of typical problems involving technology in society and their solutions. Guest speakers. Exposure to campus resources and provides a framework for developing and implementing an academic plan culminating in the award of a four-year degree.

courses.title: Project Design Principles and Applications
courses.description: [GE 5D] Selection and completion of scientific/technological synthesis application project under faculty supervision. Multidisciplinary team project. Projects that students solve in discipline of practice. Both formal written and oral reports.
courses.prerequisites: Junior or senior standing; and completion of GE Areas 1 and 2, or Areas A and B4 are recommended.

courses.title: Circuit Analysis I
courses.description: Principles of electric circuit elements including resistance, capacitance and inductance; magnetism. Basic DC network analysis techniques and theorems. DC transients and transformers, Basic AC circuit analysis techniques and theorems, Phasor analysis in AC circuits. Theory, operation, and application of basic electrical measuring instruments. 3 hours lecture/problem-solving. Corequisite(s): ETE 1021L .
courses.prerequisites: ECET or ESET major; and MAT 1060 , MAT 1300 , or MAT 1310 .

courses.title: Circuit Analysis I Laboratory
courses.description: Construct, measure voltage, current, and power in a series, parallel, and mixed DC and AC circuits. Data and error analysis of each laboratory experiment along with employment of different troubleshooting methods. Corequisite(s): ETE 1021 .
courses.prerequisites: ECET or ESET major; and MAT 1060 , MAT 1300 , or MAT 1310 .

courses.title: C/C++ Programming
courses.description: Introduction to structured programming using C/C++. Programming problems applicable to engineering technology. Control structures, Loops, Arrays, Pointers, Classes, Data structures, Data abstraction, Overloading, Templates, Files and Streams. 3 hours lecture/problem-solving. Corequisite(s): ETE 1151L .
courses.prerequisites: ESET, ETT, or EMSET major; and MAT 1060 , MAT 1300 , or MAT 1310 .

courses.title: C/C++ Programming Laboratory
courses.description: Introduction to C/C++ Programming. Writing programs using control structures, loops, functions, arrays, pointers, classes and inheritance. Corequisite(s): ETE 1151 .
courses.prerequisites: ESET, ETT, or EMSET major; and MAT 1060 , MAT 1300 , or MAT 1310 .

courses.title: Electronic Devices and Circuits
courses.description: Characteristics and applications of solid-state diodes. Characteristics and biasing of BJT and FET devices in amplifier configurations, load lines, input/output impedance and mid-band gain calculations. Frequency dependent models for BJT and FET amplifiers. Corequisite(s): ETE 2041L .
courses.prerequisites: ECET or ESET major; MAT 1300 or MAT 130; and C- or better in ETE 1021 or ETE 103, and ETE 1021L or ETE 103L.

courses.title: Electronic Devices and Circuits Laboratory
courses.description: Construction, Measurement and Testing of circuits involving solid-state diodes and their applications. Construction, Measurement and Testing of circuits involving BJT and FET devices in amplifier configurations - biasing, load lines, input/output impedance and mid-band gain measurements. Testing and confirmation of frequency dependent models for BJT and FET amplifiers. Corequisite(s): ETE 2041 .
courses.prerequisites: ECET or ESET major; MAT 1300 or MAT 130; and C- or better in ETE 1021 or ETE 103, and ETE 1021L or ETE 103L.

courses.title: Digital Circuits
courses.description: Number systems and conversions. Theory and practice of universal fundamental gates. Combinational logic, SOP and POS interconnections and conversions. Simplification theorems, applied design of MSI and LSI logic and programmable logic devices. Sequential logic, latches and flip-flops and their applications. State diagram/table. State machines (Mealy and Moore) design. State machine converter. State machine with and without control inputs. State reduction. Clocked sequential circuits, analysis and design. Analysis of timing diagrams, complex sequential logic circuits design. Algorithmic state machines. 3 hours lecture/problem-solving. Corequisite(s): ETE 2301L .
courses.prerequisites: ECET or ESET major; and C- or better in ETE 1021 or ETE 103, and ETE 1021L or ETE 103L.

courses.title: Digital Circuits Laboratory
courses.description: Number systems and conversions. Theory and practice of universal fundamental gates. Combinational logic, SOP and POS interconnections and conversions. Simplification theorems, applied design of MSI and LSI logic and programmable logic devices. Sequential logic, latches and flip-flops and their applications. State diagram/table. State machines (Mealy and Moore) design. State machine converter. State machine with and without control inputs. State reduction. Clocked sequential circuits, analysis and design. Analysis of timing diagrams, complex sequential logic circuits design. Algorithmic state machines. Corequisite(s): ETE 2301 .
courses.prerequisites: ECET or ESET major; and C- or better in ETE 1021 or ETE 103, and ETE 1021L or ETE 103L.

courses.title: Electronic CAD, Manufacturing and PCB Fabrication
courses.description: Manufacturing and fabrication processes associated with electronic products. Electronic and Mechanical Computer Aided Design (CAD) associated with Printed Circuit Board (PCB) design and manufacturing techniques. Introduction to testing and Quality assurance (QA) processes used by the Electronics Manufacturing industry. Corequisite(s): ETE 2721L .
courses.prerequisites: ESET major; C- or better in ETE 2041 or ETE 204; ETE 2041L or ETE 204L; ETE 2301 or ETE 230; and ETE 2301L or ETE 230L.

courses.title: Electronic CAD, Manufacturing and PCB Fabrication Laboratory
courses.description: Manufacturing and fabrication processes associated with electronic products. Electronic and Mechanical Computer Aided Design (CAD) associated with Printed Circuit Board (PCB) design and manufacturing techniques. Introduction to testing and Quality assurance (QA) processes used by the Electronics Manufacturing industry. Corequisite(s): ETE 2721 .
courses.prerequisites: ESET major; C- or better in ETE 2041 or ETE 204, ETE 2041L or ETE 204L, ETE 2301 or ETE 230, and ETE 2301L or ETE 230L.

courses.title: Industrial Electronics and PLC’s
courses.description: Modern industrial electronics and control devices - relays, contactors. PLCs and ladder diagram programming; Introduction to industrial control systems. DC and AC motors; three-phase power and its control, optoelectronic devices, SCRs, Triacs and other thyristor devices. Corequisite(s): ETE 2801L .
courses.prerequisites: ECET or ESET major, and C- or better in ETE 2041 or ETE 204, ETE 2041L or ETE 204L, ETE 2301 or ETE 230, and ETE 2301L or ETE 230L.

courses.title: Industrial Electronics and PLC’s Laboratory
courses.description: Modern industrial electronics and control devices - relays, contactors. PLCs and ladder diagram programming; Introduction to industrial control systems. DC and AC motors; three-phase power and its control, optoelectronic devices, SCRs, Triacs and other thyristor devices. Corequisite(s): ETE 2801 .
courses.prerequisites: ECET or ESET major, and C- or better in ETE 2041 or ETE 204, ETE 2041L , ETE 2301 or ETE 230, and ETE 2301L or ETE 230L.

courses.title: Circuit Analysis II
courses.description: RLC (Resistor-Inductor-Capacitor) Circuits, transfer functions, frequency response, Bode plots and filters. Advance analysis of circuits in the time and frequency domain employing Laplace Transforms methods. Ideal Op-Amps and applications. Second order passive and active circuits. Stability analysis. Computer Methods utilized. Corequisite(s): ETE 3101L .
courses.prerequisites: ECET or ESET major; MAT 1310 , MAT 132, or MAT 299; and C- or better in ETE 1021 or ETE 210, and ETE 1021L or ETE 210L.

courses.title: Circuit Analysis II Laboratory
courses.description: RLC (Resistor-Inductor-Capacitor) Circuits, transfer functions, frequency response, Bode plots and filters. Computer Methods utilized. Corequisite(s): ETE 3101 .
courses.prerequisites: ECET or ESET major; MAT 1310 , MAT 132, or MAT 299; and C- or better in ETE 1021 or ETE 210, and ETE 1021L or ETE 210L.

courses.title: Electronic Communication Circuits and Systems
courses.description: Introduction to periodically gated, amplitude, single sideband, frequency and phase modulation circuits and systems involved in electronic communications systems including oscillators and multistage amplifiers. Introduction to digital modulation communication techniques. Corequisite(s): ETE 3351L .
courses.prerequisites: ECET or ESET major; MAT 1310 , MAT 132, or MAT 299; and C- or better in ETE 2041 or ETE 204, and ETE 2041L or ETE 204L.

courses.title: Electronic Communication Circuits and Systems Laboratory
courses.description: Introduction to periodically gated, amplitude, single sideband, frequency and phase modulation circuits and systems involved in electronic communications systems including oscillators and multistage amplifiers. Introduction to digital modulation communication techniques. Corequisite(s): ETE 3351 .
courses.prerequisites: ECET or ESET major; MAT 1310 , MAT 132, or MAT 299; and C- or better in ETE 2041 or ETE 204, and ETE 2041L or ETE 204L.

courses.title: Microcontroller Applications
courses.description: Analysis and advanced operations of a selected microcontroller. Memory and I/O interface. I/O Ports, SCI & SPI interface, Timer functions, and Interrupts. CPU Architecture, Instruction set, Assembly Language and C programming. Corequisite(s): ETE 3441L .
courses.prerequisites: ECET or ESET major; and C- or better in ETE 2301 or ETE 230, ETE 2301L or ETE 230L, ETE 1151 or ETT 215, and ETE 1151L or ETT 215L.

courses.title: Microcontroller Applications Laboratory
courses.description: Applications of Microcontrollers associated with A/D Converters, Timers, SPI, and other I/O Devices. Writing programs using both Assembly Language and C-Language. Corequisite(s): ETE 3441 .
courses.prerequisites: ECET or ESET major; and C- or better in ETE 2301 or ETE 230, ETE 2301L or ETE 230L, ETE 1151 or ETT 215, and ETE 1151L or ETT 215L.

courses.title: Feedback Control Systems
courses.description: Modeling of continuous systems in the time and frequency domains. Block diagrams and reduction of multiple subsystems. First and Second order system response. Transient and steady-state behavior of systems. Sensitivity. Stability. Routh-Hurwitz and Root Locus Techniques. Introduction to sampling techniques, zero-order hold circuits, Z-transforms and difference equations. Digital controllers and applications in feedback systems. Corequisite(s): ETE 3501L .
courses.prerequisites: ECET or ESET major; MAT 1310 , MAT 132, or MAT 299; and C- or better in ETE 3101 or ETE 310, ETE 3101L or ETE 310L, ETE 2801 or ETE 280, and ETE 2801L or ETE 280L.

courses.title: Technical Calculus I
courses.description: [GE 2] Differential and integral calculus of polynomial, rational, trigonometric, logarithmic and exponential functions, with applications of the derivative and the integral.
courses.prerequisites: C or better in MAT 1050 and MAT 1060 ; C or better in MAT 1052 and MAT 1060 ; C or better in MAT 1055 and MAT 1060 ; C or better in MAT 1070 ; AP PreCalculus >=3; or ALEKS Comp >=76.

courses.description: Infinite series, an introduction to ordinary differential equations and Laplace transforms.
courses.prerequisites: C or better in MAT 1150 , MAT 1300 , or MAT 1300B.

courses.title: Physics of Motion, Fluids, and Heat
courses.description: [GE 5A] Introduction to Newtonian mechanics and thermodynamics: Kinematics, forces, conservation laws, viscous fluids, heat transfer, and the microscopic nature of gases. Emphasis on biological applications. Corequisite(s): PHY 1210L .
courses.prerequisites: C- or better in MAT 106, MAT 1060 , MAT 112, MAT 114, MAT 1140 , MAT 1140C, MAT 115, MAT 116, MAT 1150 , MAT 1200 , or MAT 1300 . ( MAT 1300 can be concurrent.)

courses.title: Physics of Motion, Fluids, and Heat Laboratory
courses.description: [GE 5C] Experiments on Newtonian mechanics, fluids, and heat. Corequisite(s): PHY 1210 .

courses.title: Physics of Electromagnetism, Circuits, and Light
courses.description: Electric and magnetic forces and fields, DC and AC circuits, oscillations, electromagnetic waves, optics, and analogies between diffusion and electrostatics. Corequisite(s): PHY 1220L .
courses.prerequisites: C- or better in PHY 122, PHY 122B, PHY 1210 , or PHY 1210B.

courses.title: Electromagnetism, Circuits, and Light Laboratory
courses.description: Experiments on electromagnetism, oscillations, and optics. Corequisite(s): PHY 1220 .
